question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the bracketed word to fill in the blank.**

Your words seemed more like a demand rather than a _________ (request).
solution:
The correct answer is '**plea**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate **synonym** of the given word '**request**' is '**plea**'.
 
• **Request**: an act of asking politely or formally for something. *(अनुरोध/विनंती)*
 
 
• *For example, "I would like to **request** a copy of the report, please." *
 
 
 
• **Plea**: a request made in an urgent and emotional way. *(दलील/अपील)*
 
 
• *For example, "The suspect entered a **plea** of guilty in court." *

 
 
 

**Correct Sentence:__*** Your words seemed more like a demand rather than a __**plea**__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Compromise**: an agreement reached between two parties in which each party gives up something they want in order to reach a mutual agreement. *For example, "The two sides **compromised** on the terms of the contract in order to move forward."* (समझौता)
 
• **Contract**: a written or spoken agreement between two or more parties that is enforceable by law. *For example, "We signed a **contract** to rent the apartment for one year." *(अनुबंध)
 
• **Order**: a command or instruction given by someone in a position of authority. *For example, "The boss gave the **order** to start working on the project immediately."* (आदेश)
